results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $P\in\mathbb Z[X_i:i\in I]$ and $Q_i\in\mathbb Z[Y_j:j\in J]$ for $i\in I$, and let $P(Q)$ be the image of $P$ under the ring homomorphism $X_i\mapsto Q_i$. If $d\ge1$ and $M\ge1$ satisfy $\deg Q_i\le d$ and $\|Q_i\|_1\le M$ for every $i$ such that $X_i$ occurs in $P$, then In the manuscript's notation, $\deg P(Q)\le\deg P\cdot\max(1,\max_i\deg Q_i)$ and $\|P(Q)\|_1\le\|P\|_1\max(1,\max_i\|Q_i\|_1)^{\deg P}$.

results.caption: Theorem
